controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from a measured spectrum of the star (Kiehling 1987, relative calibration). The disc is unresolved; its darker edge follows a model limb-darkening law, not a measurement.
controls.notes: The colour of Alpha Centauri B's spectrum as Kiehling (1987) measured it from the ground, 320-880 nm with a relative calibration; the observation date is not published. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
